variants.headline: Looking back: building job cancelled part-way
variants.sub: The client has abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, had been cancelled part-way.

Our movement believes an undertaking remains a matter of responsibility when its purpose is abandoned. A cancelled plan should not be made invisible by the convenience of turning attention elsewhere. Political judgment needs a standard that can address unfinished work, as well as admire an intention to begin.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We defend {target} against an automatic adverse verdict. Giving up a plan need not prove every claim of poor judgment, and a fair assessment must consider more than the disappointment attached to an unfinished undertaking.
